name: release-video
description: Makes a narrated release or product video end to end: finds what's new, writes the script and shot list, scouts and captures the app with callout rings on what the narration names, records it in the user's ElevenLabs voice, adds a music bed and mixes to mp4; use for "make a release video for v1.2", "a launch video for this version", "redo the video with callouts", "reuse that voice style".
